```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(annotables)
library(PCAtools)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(ggrepel)
```

tidyverse: data manipulation, including joining, filtering, and renaming

DESeq2: statistical analysis of differential expression from RNA-seq counts

annotables: gene annotation tables linking IDs to names, locations, and gene types

PCAtools: PCA visualization

EnhancedVolcano: volcano plots displaying differential expression results

clusterProfiler: functional enrichment analysis of gene sets

# Pre-filtering

## Low counts

```{r}
smallestGroupSize <- 4
keep <- rowSums(raw_counts >= 10) >= smallestGroupSize
raw_counts_filtered <- raw_counts[keep,]
```

Retain a gene if its count is at least 10 in at least four samples.

| Example counts across eight samples | Samples with count ≥ 10 | Retained? |
|-------------------------------------|-------------------------|-----------|
| `12, 15, 20, 11, 0, 0, 0, 0`        | 4                       | Yes       |
| `100, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0`          | 1                       | No        |
| `9, 9, 9, 9, 9, 9, 9, 9`            | 0                       | No        |

```{r}
dim(raw_counts)
dim(raw_counts_filtered)
```

dim() dimension

```         
[1] 63677     8 [1] 16139     8
```

## Convert ENSEMBL to SYMBOL

```{r}
gene_anno <- data.frame(ensgene = rownames(raw_counts_filtered)) %>%
  left_join(grch37, by= "ensgene") %>%
  distinct(symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% # sometimes one ENSEMBL might have two different SYMBOLs or ENTREZ. It might happen where there are multiple isoforms of one gene etc. This makes sure that when an ENS is doubled, we only take the first observation.
  rename(gene_start = start, gene_end = end, gene_strand = strand) # start/end/strand are reserved names in rowData (GRanges), so DESeq2 would error
head(gene_anno)
dim(gene_anno)
```

This converts a list of retained gene identifiers into a table containing biological information about those genes.

```{r}
data.frame(ensgene = rownames(raw_counts_filtered))
```

This step places Ensembl gene IDs into an annotation table.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
data.frame(ensgene = rownames(raw_counts_filtered)) %>%
  left_join(grch37, by = "ensgene")
```

grch37 is a human gene annotation table supplied by annotables. It provides information: gene symbols, Entrez IDs, chromosome locations, and biological types. (grch37 right table)

```{r}
data.frame(ensgene = rownames(raw_counts_filtered)) %>%
  left_join(grch37, by = "ensgene") %>%
  distinct(symbol, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

This keeps the first record for each distinct gene symbol.

## Retain only protein coding genes

```{r}
unique(gene_anno$biotype)
```

```{r}
table(gene_anno$biotype)
```

```{r}
gene_anno <- gene_anno %>%
  filter(biotype == 'protein_coding') %>%
  filter(!grepl("^MT-", symbol, ignore.case = TRUE)) # remove mitochondrial genes (MT- human, mt- mouse)
dim(gene_anno)
```

The first filter retains genes annotated as protein-coding.

The second filter removes genes whose symbols begin with MT-.

```{r}
raw_counts_filtered <- raw_counts_filtered[gene_anno$ensgene, ] # retain only protein coding genes
rownames(raw_counts_filtered) <- gene_anno$symbol # replace ENS with symbols count table
rownames(gene_anno) <- gene_anno$symbol
dim(raw_counts_filtered)
```

First line: It selects count rows using the retained Ensembl IDs and arranges them in the order of gene_anno.

2nd and 3rd line: These replace the row labels with readable gene symbols.


# DESeq2 Workflow Part I

```{r}
mtd$dex <- factor(mtd$dex, levels = c('untrt', 'trt'))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = raw_counts_filtered, 
                              colData = mtd,
                              rowData = gene_anno,
                              design = ~ cell + dex)
```

```{r}
mtd$dex <- factor(mtd$dex, levels = c('untrt', 'trt'))
```

put 'untrt' first \>\> set untreated samples as the reference

```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = raw_counts_filtered, 
                              colData = mtd,
                              rowData = gene_anno,
                              design = ~ cell + dex)
```

DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(): a DESeq2 function that combines a count matrix, metadata, and a design formula into a DESeqDataSet object.

design = \~ cell + dex

two factor used here to model gene expression: cell line and treatment

In this paired experiment, each cell line has both treated and untreated samples. Including cell lets the model account for that pairing when estimating the drug effect.

```{r}
class(dds)
```

```{r}
dds
```

Display its dimensions and stored information

```{r}
colData(dds)
```

sample metadata

```{r}

```

gene_anno

```{r}
dds@design
```

the design formula

```{r}
head(counts(dds))
```

```{r}
dds <- DESeq(dds)

```

Estimates size factors for normalization, estimates gene dispersions, and fits negative binomial models with Wald tests

```{r}
dds
```

```{r}
as.data.frame(colData(dds))
```

```{r}
head(counts(dds, normalize = TRUE))
```

```{r}
vsd <- vst(dds, blind=FALSE)
vsd
```

vst stands for variance-stabilizing transformation.

blind means whether take design = \~ cell + dex into consideration. blind = FALSE means taking into consideration.

```{r}
pca_plot <- vsd %>%
  assay %>%
  pca(., vsd@colData, removeVar = 0.9) %>% # remove 90% of lower variance -> retains top 10% most variable genes
  biplot(colby = "cell",  shape = 'dex', legendPosition = 'right', lab = NULL )
pca_plot
```

assay(vsd): This extracts the transformed expression matrix from vsd.

pca(., [vsd\@colData](mailto:vsd@colData){.email}, removeVar = 0.9)

removeVar = 0.9 removes the 90% lowest-variance genes

biplot() create a plot with two dimensions (x and y axis).

|                          |                                            |
|--------------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| colby = "cell"           | Colors points by cell line                 |
| shape = 'dex'            | Uses different shapes for treatment groups |
| legendPosition = 'right' | Places the legend on the right             |
| lab = NULL               | Hides sample-name labels                   |

PCA: Each point represents one sample.

# DESeq Workflow Part II

## Differential Expression Test

```{r}
resultsNames(dds)
```

```{r}
res <- results(dds, name = "dex_trt_vs_untrt", alpha = 0.05) # alpha is the p-value threshold to whether call a gene significant or not.

# alternatively (gives the same numbers, but lfcShrink() cannot be given this res, because it needs the coefficient name)
# res <- results(dds, contrast = c("dex", "trt", "untrt"), alpha = 0.05)
```

```{r}
summary(res)
```

```{r}
head(res)
```

## Adjusted p-value and multiple testing correction

```{r}
sum(res$pvalue < 0.05)
```

```{r}
0.05 * sum(res$padj < 0.05)
```

```{r}
p_hist <- ggplot(res, aes(x=pvalue)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_bw()

p_hist
```

```{r}
# BiocManager::install("apeglm")
res <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = 'dex_trt_vs_untrt', res = res ,type='apeglm')
```

## Volcano Plot

```{r}
p_volcano_enhanced <- EnhancedVolcano(res,
                lab = rownames(res),
                x = 'log2FoldChange',
                y = 'padj',
                title = 'Dex: trt vs. untrt', subtitle = NULL,
                pCutoff = 0.05,
                FCcutoff = 0,
                pointSize = 1.0)
```

```{r}
padj_cutoff <- 0.05
lfc_cutoff <- 0

deg_table <- res %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  mutate(geneid = rownames(.)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
  mutate(
    diffexpressed = case_when(padj > padj_cutoff ~ "NS",
                              log2FoldChange > lfc_cutoff & padj < padj_cutoff ~ "UP",
                              log2FoldChange < -lfc_cutoff & padj < padj_cutoff ~ "DOWN",
                              TRUE ~ "NS"))
```

```{r}
head(deg_table)
```

```{r}
table(deg_table$diffexpressed)
```

```{r}
table(deg_table$diffexpressed)
```

```{r}
p_volcano_basic <- ggplot(deg_table, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(padj), color = diffexpressed)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = lfc_cutoff, linetype= 'dashed', color = 'gray') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = padj_cutoff,linetype= 'dashed', color = 'gray') +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(DOWN = '#2E6DB4', NS = "gray40", UP="#D6403A"))+ 
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  coord_cartesian() +
  ggtitle('Dex: trt vs. untrt')
```

Exercise 4

```{r}
## prepare deg table
prepare_deg_table <- function(res,
                              padj_cutoff = 0.05,
                              lfc_cutoff = 0) {
  
  deg_table <- res %>%
    data.frame() %>%
    mutate(geneid = rownames(.)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
    mutate(
      diffexpressed = case_when(
        padj > padj_cutoff ~ "NS",
        log2FoldChange > lfc_cutoff & padj < padj_cutoff ~ "UP",
        log2FoldChange < -lfc_cutoff & padj < padj_cutoff ~ "DOWN",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )
  
  return(deg_table) 
  
}
  
## volcano plot
library(ggrepel)
volcano_plot <- function(deg_table,
                         ntop_deg_labels = 20) {
  
  top20 <- deg_table%>%
    filter(diffexpressed != "NS")%>%
    arrange(padj)%>%
    slice_head(n = ntop_deg_labels)
  
  
  p <- ggplot(deg_table, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(padj), color = diffexpressed)) +
    geom_point(size = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = lfc_cutoff, linetype= 'dashed', color = 'gray') +
    geom_hline(yintercept = padj_cutoff,linetype= 'dashed', color = 'gray') +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(DOWN = '#2E6DB4', NS = "gray40", UP="#D6403A"))+ 
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    coord_cartesian() +
    ggtitle('Dex: trt vs. untrt')+
    geom_text_repel(data = top20, aes(label = geneid), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) 
  
  return(p)
}

  
```

# Pathway enrichment analysis

```{r}
# Define gene sets
# background genes = all tested genes
universe <- rownames(deg_table)
down_genes <- deg_table[deg_table$diffexpressed == 'DOWN', 'geneid']
```

```{r}
## BiocManager::install("org.Hs.eg.db")
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
GO_down <- enrichGO(down_genes, 
                    OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", # Human database
                    keyType = "SYMBOL", 
                    ont = "BP",
                    universe = universe, 
                    qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                    readable = TRUE) 
```

```{r}
GO_down_plot <- dotplot(GO_down, 
        x='FoldEnrichment', 
        showCategory = 15) +
  ggtitle("GO:BP, DOWN")
GO_down_plot 
```

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=7}
# Some GO terms are reduntant. simplify should help remove redundancy but it might be computationally demanding. 
GO_down_clean <- clusterProfiler::simplify(GO_down)
GO_down_clean_plot <- dotplot(GO_down_clean, 
        x='FoldEnrichment', 
        showCategory = 15,
        font.size = 9,
        label_format = 30) +
  ggtitle("GO:BP, DOWN_CLEAN")
GO_down_clean_plot
```

```{r}
up_genes <- deg_table[deg_table$diffexpressed == 'UP', 'geneid']
GO_up <- enrichGO(up_genes, 
                    OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", # Human database
                    keyType = "SYMBOL", 
                    ont = "BP",
                    universe = universe, 
                    qvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                    readable = TRUE) 
```

```{r}
GO_up_clean <- clusterProfiler::simplify(GO_up)
GO_up_clean_plot <- dotplot(GO_up_clean, 
        x='FoldEnrichment', 
        showCategory = 15,
        font.size = 9,
        label_format = 30) +
  ggtitle("GO:BP, UP_CLEAN")
GO_up_clean_plot
```

```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=9}
## Exercise 6

GO_up_clean_plot | GO_down_clean_plot
```
